tools.name: filmrightsproof.search_public_records
tools.description: Free bounded search of maintained U.S. Copyright Office evidence with on-demand current CPRS verification when reachable. Use to resolve likely work candidates before a deeper trace; inspect the returned freshness state.

tools.name: filmrightsproof.trace_public_rights
tools.description: Build an evidence-backed public-record rights dossier across maintained registrations, renewals, recordations, terminations, related public records, and bounded current CPRS verification. Preserve freshness and fallback state. This is not a legal ownership opinion or title clearance.
